description_en: Creates a database account under a specified tenant
description_zh: 在指定租户下创建一个访问数据库的账号
kebab_example: aliyun oceanbasepro create-tenant-user --instance-id ob317v4uif0000 --tenant-id t4pnum0000 --user-name pay_test --user-type Normal --user-password '!Aliyun4Oceanbase' --roles '[{"Database":"oceanbase1","Role":"readwrite"},{"Database":"oceanbase2","Role":"readonly"}]' --description this_is_a_test_database --encryption-type RAS --global-permissions Encrypt,Decrypt --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTenantUser

parameters.help_en: The ID of the OceanBase cluster
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database account.  
Certain reserved keywords such as SYS and root cannot be used
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号名称。  
不能使用某些预留关键字，如 SYS、root 等
parameters.name: user_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the user. Valid values:  

Normal: standard account.
Admin: superuser account.
ReadonlyAccount: read-only account. Only MySQL tenants support read-only accounts
parameters.help_zh:
用户类型。  

Normal：普通账户。
Admin：超级账户。
ReadonlyAccount：只读账户，仅 MySQL 租户包含只读账户
parameters.name: user_type

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters. The password must be 10 to 32 characters in length. Special characters include: !@#$%^*()_+-=
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号访问密码。
必须包含大写英文字符、小写英文字符、数字、特殊字符占三种，长度为 10-32 位； 特殊字符为：!@#$%^*()_+-=
parameters.name: user_password

parameters.help_en:
The role information of the user. For standard users, specify the account information as a JSON-formatted character string. The value is an array that contains Database (MySQL pattern) information and role information (Role). Roles include the following types: Read and write permission (ReadWrite): ALL PRIVILEGES. Read-only permission (ReadOnly): SELECT. DDL permission (DDL): CREATE, DROP, ALTER, SHOW VIEW, CREATE VIEW. DML permission: SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW. DML permission (DML): SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW.
  • Oracle pattern: leave this parameter empty.
  • MySQL pattern: the superuser account has ALL PRIVILEGES by default. Leave this parameter empty.
parameters.help_zh:
用户的角色信息。 普通用户填写账户的信息，其为 JSON 格式的字符串，默认为一个数组，数组内包含 Database（MySQL 模式）信息和角色信息（Role）。角色包含以下几类： 读写权限（ReadWrite）：ALL PRIVILEGES。 只读权限（ReadOnly）：SELECT。 DDL 权限（DDL）：CREATE,DROP,ALTER,SHOW VIEW,CREATE VIEW。 DML 权限：SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE, SHOW VIEW。 DML 权限（DML）：SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,DELETE,SHOW VIEW。
  • Oracle 模式：无需填写。
  • MySQL 模式：超级账户默认为 ALL PRIVILEGES，无需填写。
parameters.name: roles
